title: Pursuit Completes Strategic Divestiture of Flyover Business, Strengthening Focus on Growth in Iconic Destinations
summary: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit”) (NYSE: PRSU) today announced that it has completed the sale of its Flyover flying theater attraction business (“Flyover”) to Brogent Technologies Inc. for $75 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, representing a multiple of approximately 14.5 times Flyover’s 2025 Adjusted EBITDA contribution.
